You have to ask for help if you need it and press. It’s incredibly hard post baby to do many things, and the lack of visitors allowed makes it more difficult, don’t let a midwife dismiss your cries for help or ignore you.

Try to get sleep before you arrive for an induction and do your best to sleep while you’re waiting for your induction to work. I didn’t and ended up living on 2 hours of sleep at most in one go for 6 days.
